scenarios.trigger: policy exception tries to waive non-waivable source truth or protected separation
scenarios.recovery_action: reject waiver and keep ordinary policy in force
scenarios.pass_condition: incident is contained, public claims are narrowed if needed, and FT-0181 remains live unless real closeout evidence exists

scenarios.trigger: release audit hash mismatch after unpacking
scenarios.recovery_action: treat package as non-release candidate until hashes and generated artifacts are rebuilt
scenarios.pass_condition: decision-board artifact is narrowed to before/after effects, FT-0181 remains live absent real evidence, and no closure claim is made

scenarios.trigger: post-decision change ticket is used to authorize lifecycle, public-summary, schema, validator, or closeout changes without a bounded post-decision ticket
scenarios.recovery_action: suppress the change, write or repair the ticket, name rollback owner/triggers and public claim ceiling, then keep FT-0181 live until real closeout evidence exists
scenarios.pass_condition: overbroad change is reversed or blocked and FT-0181 remains live unless real closeout evidence exists

scenarios.trigger: post-decision change ticket is narrow but the first live window expands users, date range, source system, tools, memory, schema fields, or public claims without a live-window stop/rollback card
scenarios.recovery_action: pause or roll back the window, suppress public claims, return to owner for bounded scope and executable rollback, and keep FT-0181 live until closeout evidence exists
scenarios.pass_condition: live-window drift is contained, public claims are frozen or narrowed, and FT-0181 remains live unless real closeout evidence exists
